svg.title: Spectrograms, 16 kHz clip low-passed at 3.8 kHz
svg.desc: Three spectrograms of the same synthetic voice clip at a 16 kHz sample rate: the reference, a telephone-like version low-passed at 3.8 kilohertz, and the processed version with the band above the cutoff rebuilt.
svg.text: Spectrograms, 16 kHz clip low-passed at 3.8 kHz
Reference (16 kHz, full band to 7.2 kHz)
